# Charangan Vasantharajan

> Engineering Manager, AI Platform Architecture, at Iterate.ai in Toronto, Canada.
> He is the architect of Generate, Iterate.ai's enterprise agentic AI platform, and leads
> the team that builds it. Generate won AI Product of the Year from both Pinnacle and TMC in 2025.

Canonical page: https://chaarangan.github.io/

## Experience

**Engineering Manager, AI Platform Architecture, Iterate.ai** (Sep 2024 to present)

- Architect of Generate since it was an edge app; owns its architecture, roadmap (with the
  CTO), and cloud and tooling budget, and leads the cross-functional team that builds it.
- Invented permission-aware file search that answers over 400 TB+ of enterprise storage at
  p95 under 1 second with no embeddings and no content index. Files are read in place on
  NetApp ONTAP and Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP, under NFSv4 ACLs resolved through Active
  Directory and Microsoft Entra Domain Services. US patent application pending. It is the
  core of Generate's storage editions with NetApp (https://iterate.ai/partners/netapp).
- Built the agent runtime: LangGraph workflows with human-in-the-loop approval, a gVisor or
  Kata sandbox per agent session, graph memory on Neo4j or Amazon Neptune, and each AI
  service bound to its own certified model. Versioned policies and DLP attach to any
  project, agent, or workflow.
- Delivered an air-gapped install for a U.S. Federal Defense Agency on DISA STIG-hardened RHEL 9
  with FIPS enabled.
- Designed and built Generate Sentinel, the release plane: one-command online and
  air-gapped installs, customer entitlements, and releases published from GitHub Actions
  through OIDC roles into AWS.
- Shipped healthcare revenue-cycle work (X12 835/837 claims and remittance, a Cerner
  integration) and launched Generate through IBM with Hutchinson Regional Healthcare,
  featured in IBM's product blog. Built scheduled assortment and retail-audit agents for
  Vuori.
- Runs the team AI-native. 100% of production code is written by AI under spec-driven
  development, and his review sits on the spec and the architecture. A task that took 4 to
  5 weeks now ships in a week, and merged PRs are up 65% to 95%.
- Doubled the team in a year: 6 hires, 2 promotions to Senior Applied AI Engineer.
- Works with partner engineers at IBM, NetApp, Intel, AMD, and HP.

**Data Scientist, Iterate.ai** (Nov 2023 to Sep 2024)

## What Generate is

An enterprise agentic AI platform for agents, workflows, and search over a company's
private data. One codebase deploys to AWS (EKS, MSK, Aurora, Neptune), customer-managed
on-prem and OpenShift, and air-gapped RHEL. Air-gapped installs keep the full feature set
with no outbound network, and that constraint shaped most design decisions.

- **Search where the data lives.** Permission-aware file search reads storage in place.
- **Sandboxed execution.** Each agent session runs in its own sandbox, so a compromised
  session cannot reach another tenant.
- **Agent memory past the context window.** Graph memory carries user context across 30 to
  40 minute sessions and compacts the working context as it fills.
- **Governance.** Every model passes a compatibility suite before it serves a platform AI
  service; policies and DLP attach to projects, agents, and workflows.
- **Distribution.** Generate Sentinel installs online or air-gapped with one command.
- **Scale and cost.** 99.8% uptime at 50,000+ requests/second peak. Consolidation and
  connection pooling cut infrastructure cost 33% and improved performance 4x.

## Open source

- [Stepgate](https://github.com/Chaarangan/stepgate): MCP server that shows an agent one step at a time and moves on only when mechanical checks pass; 1,400+ npm downloads
- [MedBERT](https://huggingface.co/Charangan/MedBERT): biomedical language model for named entity recognition; 570,000+ Hugging Face downloads
- [NERP](https://github.com/Chaarangan/NERP): Python framework for transformer-based named entity recognition; 72,000+ PyPI downloads
